Also estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage requires distance. We have distance 750 miles. We need to know fuel tank capacity 50 gallons. Need current fuel level. We can display fuel status. Then estimate drive feasibility. So call displayCarStatus with option "fuel". Then estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage with distance 750.
